newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ansett Australia welcomes single market move.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ansett Australia welcomes single market move.

text.p: Ansett Australia welcomed on Thursday the Australian government's formation of a single aviation market (SAM) with New Zealand.

"Ansett has always supported the concept of a single aviation market, so we welcome the decision of both governments to open the trans-Tasman market," Ansett spokeswoman Jane Corbett-Jones told Reuters.
"We see competition on that route or any route as being beneficial to passengers and carriers alike."

Earlier on Thursday, the Australian and New Zealand governments signed the single aviation market agreement, under which airlines in both countries would have unrestricted rights to fly anywhere in the other country.
The agreement is to take effect on November 1.
